Hi, everyone!

I was surprised that there wasn't already a sub for this topic, so I decided to make one. I know it's a tad redundant, with there already being a pretty cool community in /v/asatru, but I wanted a place where we could filter everything to do with continental Germanic Heathenism, as the traditions and tribes do differ from our Scandinavian and Icelandic brethren.

For more info, please read the FAQ (COMING SOON!)

For now, a few ground rules:

Be Tolerant: Tolerating someone and their opinion doesn't mean you have to agree with it or like it, but we do expect everyone here to partake in civil discourse. Yes, we heathens like to gripe a lot, but at the end of the day we should still be able to clink tankards and wish each-other well. Therefore, please show respect to other peoples' opinions and do your best to be polite.

No Racism: Germanic Paganism already has quite a reputation for being favored among racists, and we have quite a few opponents that seem well-embedded into that theory, even though the vast majority of us are anything but racist. If you hold racist views, please just keep it to yourself. If you don't want us excluding you from the conversation, then don't exclude others. It's that simple.

Have Fun and Learn Something New: This is the most important rule. We're here to relax, discuss, and share knowledge, not kill each-other over it.

That being said, here is the moderator guidelines that we pledge to you:

We will not hold grudges.

We will not discriminate based on race, religion, or political affiliation.

We will not delete posts blatantly or deliberately without just cause.

We will show the same respect to all as we ask is shown to us.

If you have any questions, comments, or concerns, please let us know.

If you are a Theodist and feel you could be an integral moderator, please PM me.
